items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had a sidekick named, I think, Scotty Robinson, who was a straight man. They had a little comedy routine.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was a pretty good dancer. He had a sidekick named, I think, Scotty Robinson, who was a straight man. They had a little comedy routine.
And he was the butt of all the jokes?
